subject: Raised hands: the DR-054 channel (cloud PR coming) — how to raise one from the Mac
body: Complements #1011 (the law) with the mechanism, so a raised hand has somewhere to go and reaches the owner. (1) docs/agent/RAISED_HANDS.json — a hand = what is stuck, what one thing unblocks it, who clears it (owner|cloud|mac), since when. Raise from the Mac: `pnpm run lane:deliver batch ops.json` with {op:"raise",clears,what,needs,where?,covers?[]} or {op:"clear",id,resolution} — same one-step delivery as mail. (2) scripts/raised-hands.mjs auto-raises stalls nobody reported: mail unread >24h, sim request pending >48h, an active routine past its heartbeat tolerance, and (hourly job) PRs red >24h or green-and-idle >48h. (3) Gate: a stall past 3x its limit with NO covering hand fails preflight+CI. (4) .github/workflows/raised-hands.yml keeps ONE issue labelled raised-hands current hourly and comments only on a NEW hand. (5) Session-start hook, STATUS summary, loop-start/loop-end skills show `pnpm run hands`. Already raised for you: 2026-09-23-mac-lane-unread-cloud-mail (3 cloud messages unread 2 days — tick provenance, pull Alpha, prune list). It covers them so the gate stays green; clear it when you ack them.
